about: 现在带大约 20 个人做测试，看着虚拟键盘、HiMouse 和文件管理。发布赶的时候，我主要看两件事：这次交不交得出去，漏掉的问题是从哪漏的。
再往前，我在同一条产品线上写代码，用 ArkTS 和 C++ 做折叠屏电脑的虚拟键盘和扩展显示模式。2023 年夏天在上海快手实习。本科在马里兰大学，硕士在美国东北大学。

principles.title: 先看漏在哪
principles.body: 功能、性能和稳不稳，发布前放在一起看。真漏了，再查是用例没写到，还是没照着做。

principles.title: 日志得能用
principles.body: 出了问题，日志里要说得清。说不清就只能猜。

principles.title: 重复的交给脚本
principles.body: 回归和交付能自动化，就别靠人盯着。

en.metaDescription: Ian, a software engineer in Dongguan. System software, distributed systems, and release quality. Currently a testing manager at Huawei.
en.name: Ian
en.lede: I live in Dongguan and work on system software at Huawei. I've done both testing and development, and spent a summer at Kuaishou on large models.

facts.label: Focus
facts.value: System software, distributed systems, performance and stability

stats.label: People on the testing team I lead
Requests per second in the distributed project

about: I lead a testing team of about 20, on the virtual keyboard, HiMouse, and file manager. When a release is tight, I watch two things: whether we can actually ship, and where a missed bug slipped through.

Before that I was on the same product line, writing the foldable PC's virtual keyboard and Exfusion display mode in ArkTS and C++. In the summer of 2023 I interned at Kuaishou in Shanghai. I did my bachelor's at Maryland and my master's at Northeastern.

principles.title: Find the leak
principles.body: Function, performance, and stability get looked at together before a release. If something escapes, I check whether the case was missing or just not run.

principles.title: Logs have to work
principles.body: If the log can't explain the bug, the next step is guessing.

principles.title: Script the repetition
principles.body: If regression or delivery can be automated, it shouldn't depend on someone watching.

bullets: Led a testing team of about 20 across the virtual keyboard, HiMouse, and file manager, keeping delivery stable through tight release cycles.
Designed and ran end-to-end test strategies covering function, performance, and stability.
Traced escaped defects to gaps in strategy or execution, and used that to improve release quality.
Wrote automation scripts that reduced regression issues and sped up testing.
Built system features for Huawei's foldable PC, including the virtual keyboard and Exfusion display mode, in ArkTS and C++.
Found and fixed performance bottlenecks and functional bugs, improving responsiveness and stability.
Designed developer-level tests and raised branch coverage above 80%.
Added system-level logging and analytics so debugging and optimization had evidence to work from.
Automated the CI/CD pipeline for binary delivery and cut down manual integration.
Optimized distributed training and inference for large language models with TensorFlow and PyTorch, improving resource utilization by about 20%.
Analyzed the vLLM inference engine and benchmarked it against Faster Transformer.
Evaluated Paged Attention and LLaMA-7B inference efficiency to inform the framework choice.

project.title: High-concurrency distributed system
project.summary: A distributed system built for high concurrency. Incoming requests are spread across servers, and slower work is queued so the front and back ends are not tied together.
bullets: Handled about 200,000 requests at roughly 2,000 per second.
Architecture used AWS EC2, a load balancer, and multiple Tomcat servers.
Used RabbitMQ for asynchronous processing, decoupling the system and making the backend more reliable.
Raised throughput under high concurrency with dynamic thread allocation.

skills.value: Distributed systems, system optimization, performance tuning
